class.name: Omake
class.brief_description: A singleton for holding the Omake functions.
class.description: These are bonus functions that may be useful, but not necessarily as part of the core Blazium engine.

method.name: add_clampedi
method.description: Returns a + b, but will return max instead of overflow, or min instead of underflow. By default min is INT64_MIN and max is INT64_MAX.

method.name: get_cpu_ticks_nsec
method.description: Returns the CPU ticks in nanoseconds.
